title: Mawdeep: ambushes, secret rooms and shortcuts
changes: Each floor now starts on a safe, lit landing where no monsters appear.
Ambush rooms: beast-folk wait in the dark, with only their glowing eyes showing, and rush you all at once when you walk in. One per floor keeps a hoard chest.
Every floor hides a cracked wall. Break through it to find a secret room with a rich chest.
Shortcuts: a barred gate at the far end of the first two floors opens a back tunnel to the start. It can only be opened from the deep side, then stays open for a while.
Redrawn racks, skull poles, meat hooks, flaying frames, pikes and torches with proper timber and darker iron.
